pl.description: Zwraca listę wszystkich graczy wraz z ich postaciami i danymi PU.

en.description: Returns all players with their character rosters and PU data.

pl.description: Zwraca pojedynczego gracza po nazwie. Zwraca 404 jeśli gracz nie istnieje.

en.description: Returns a single player by name. Returns 404 if the player does not exist.

pl.description: Tworzy nowego gracza z opcjonalną pierwszą postacią. Pole 'name' jest wymagane.

bodyFields.name: name
bodyFields.description: Nazwa gracza. Musi być unikalna w repozytorium.
bodyFields.validation: Wymagane — żądanie zostanie odrzucone z kodem 400 jeśli brak.

bodyFields.name: margonemId
bodyFields.description: Identyfikator konta Margonem gracza.

bodyFields.name: prfWebhook
bodyFields.description: URL webhooka Discord do powiadomień PRF.

bodyFields.name: triggers
bodyFields.description: Wzorce wyzwalaczy powiadomień dla gracza.

bodyFields.name: characterName
bodyFields.description: Nazwa pierwszej postaci gracza. Jeśli podana, postać zostanie utworzona razem z graczem.

bodyFields.name: characterSheet
bodyFields.description: URL karty postaci dla pierwszej postaci.

bodyFields.name: initialPUStart
bodyFields.description: Początkowa wartość PU dla pierwszej postaci.

bodyFields.name: noCharacterFile
bodyFields.description: Jeśli true, pomija tworzenie pliku postaci na dysku.

en.description: Creates a new player with an optional initial character. The 'name' field is required.

bodyFields.name: name
bodyFields.description: Player name. Must be unique in the repository.
bodyFields.validation: Required — request will be rejected with 400 if missing.

bodyFields.name: margonemId
bodyFields.description: Margonem account identifier for the player.

bodyFields.name: prfWebhook
bodyFields.description: Discord webhook URL for PRF notifications.

bodyFields.name: triggers
bodyFields.description: Notification trigger patterns for the player.

bodyFields.name: characterName
bodyFields.description: Name of the initial character. If provided, the character will be created along with the player.

bodyFields.name: characterSheet
bodyFields.description: Character sheet URL for the initial character.

bodyFields.name: initialPUStart
bodyFields.description: Starting PU value for the initial character.

bodyFields.name: noCharacterFile
bodyFields.description: If true, skips character file creation on disk.

pl.description: Dodaje nową postać do istniejącego gracza. Pole 'characterName' jest wymagane. Parametr ':name' w ścieżce to nazwa gracza.

bodyFields.name: characterName
bodyFields.description: Nazwa nowej postaci. Musi być unikalna wśród postaci gracza.
bodyFields.validation: Wymagane — żądanie zostanie odrzucone z kodem 400 jeśli brak.

bodyFields.name: characterSheet
bodyFields.description: URL karty postaci.

bodyFields.name: initialPUStart
bodyFields.description: Początkowa wartość PU dla postaci.

bodyFields.name: noCharacterFile
bodyFields.description: Jeśli true, pomija tworzenie pliku postaci na dysku.

bodyFields.name: condition
bodyFields.description: Stan lub kondycja postaci (np. zdrowy, ranny).

bodyFields.name: specialItems
bodyFields.description: Lista nazw specjalnych przedmiotów przypisanych do postaci.

bodyFields.name: filePath
bodyFields.description: Niestandardowa ścieżka pliku postaci. Jeśli pominięta, używana jest ścieżka domyślna.

en.description: Adds a new character to an existing player. The 'characterName' field is required. The ':name' path parameter is the player name.

bodyFields.name: characterName
bodyFields.description: Name of the new character. Must be unique among the player's characters.
bodyFields.validation: Required — request will be rejected with 400 if missing.

bodyFields.name: characterSheet
bodyFields.description: Character sheet URL.

bodyFields.name: initialPUStart
bodyFields.description: Starting PU value for the character.

bodyFields.name: noCharacterFile
bodyFields.description: If true, skips character file creation on disk.

bodyFields.name: condition
bodyFields.description: Character condition or state (e.g. healthy, wounded).

bodyFields.name: specialItems
bodyFields.description: List of special item names assigned to the character.

bodyFields.name: filePath
bodyFields.description: Custom character file path. If omitted, the default path is used.
